event: He comes out into a long, low, golden room, firelit and warm, a table laid with steaming food.
A tall hooded host rises at the table's head, hands open: come in, sit, eat, you're safe here.
He sets the drum and the chain down at the threshold, and does not step across.
The hearth throws no heat, and nothing in the gold casts a true shadow but him and his maul.
The host's welcome loops; the pale shapes under the table are bones; a pull urges him to sit.
The warmth runs back past the hearth, richer and kinder the deeper it reaches.
On the threshold-stone he pours all three unspent points into his Will.

event: His will sets hard; the pull breaks on it, a pressure he chooses to refuse.
